svg.title: V2 validation objective comparison
svg.desc: Four panels compare effective rank, velocity-probe R-squared, position action-contrast error, and velocity action-contrast error for each v2 objective and the supervised visual control. Every completed seed is shown. The selected objective is marked only when validation gates select one.
svg.title: V2 validation objective comparison

cc:Work.dc:title: V2 validation objective comparison
